card.name: Career and education history in biographies
card.fires_on: Small linking words (after, in, during, left, began, and) inside short biographies describing someone's schooling, jobs or career steps.

modes.label: Education and career transitions
modes.description: A linking word or verb right after a life event, leading into the next school or job step.
modes.example: Cooper was born on February 28, 1930, in New York City.<< After>> graduating from the Bronx High School of Science

modes.label: Job or role description
modes.description: A word like in or during that introduces a person's work role or time in college.
modes.example: Elizabeth Zwaaf is a Marketing Communications Specialist at Elsevier.<< In>> this role she helps to promote the work
